stories.title: Serie A, Venezia-Lazio 0-2: biancocelesti in vetta con Roma e Inter. Lagunari ancora a secco

en.title: Serie A, Venezia-Lazio 0-2: biancocelesti joint top with Roma and Inter. Lagunari still without a win
en.summary: Lazio defeated Venezia 2-0 to join Roma and Inter at the top of Serie A. Inter drew 2-2 with Roma, while Bologna and Torino tied 1-1, and Udinese beat Cagliari 1-0.

stories.title: Prof accoltellata a Roma, in rete il video shock: “Istigato dai suprematisti”

en.title: Teacher stabbed in Rome, shocking video online: "Instigated by supremacists"
en.summary: Video footage has emerged showing an alleged stabbing attack on a teacher in Rome, with claims linking the incident to supremacist influence. Authorities are examining the attacker's communications.

stories.title: Mazzola e Rivera, il mito della Staffetta che divideva un Paese

en.title: Mazzola and Rivera, the myth of the Rotation that divided a Country
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola and Gianni Rivera were rival players who became famous for their historic alternating role in Italy's 1970 World Cup campaign in Mexico.

stories.title: Il figlio di Sandro Mazzola: “Papà alle mie partite si nascondeva tra i tifosi”

en.title: Sandro Mazzola's son: "Dad would hide among the fans at my matches"
en.summary: The son of footballer Sandro Mazzola recalls his father's preference for attending his matches incognito among spectators rather than in official seating.

stories.title: La Lazio vince 2-0 a Venezia e aggancia Inter e Roma in vetta

en.title: Lazio wins 2-0 at Venice and draws level with Inter and Roma at the top
en.summary: Lazio secured a 2-0 victory at Venice through goals from Zaccagni and Noslin, moving into a three-way tie for first place in the league standings.

stories.title: Salvini chiude la porta ai nordisti: “La Lega vince solo quando è unita”

en.title: Salvini closes door to northerners: "The League wins only when united"
en.summary: Salvini addressed regional governors at Pontida who had advocated for a federal reorganization of the League party, emphasizing the need for party unity.

stories.title: Gli Houthi all’Italia: “Non siamo in guerra con voi, ma i vostri aerei sono lì”. Riad sotto attacco

en.title: Houthis to Italy: "We are not at war with you, but your aircraft are there". Riyadh under attack
en.summary: Houthi rebels attacked Saudi Arabia's capital, with fire and smoke reported near the airport. The group told Italy it is not in conflict with the country but questioned the presence of Italian aircraft in the region.

stories.title: Salvini a Pontida, la Lega vince solo se è forte e unita, da Nord a Sud

en.title: Salvini at Pontida, the League wins only if strong and united, from North to South
en.summary: Salvini addressed the League party at Pontida, stressing the importance of maintaining strength and unity across all regions without overconfidence or despair.

stories.title: Attacco Houthi su Riad, poi avvertono Roma: “Non in guerra con voi, ma con i jet sostenete i sauditi”

en.title: Houthi Attack on Riyadh, then warn Rome: "Not at war with you, but you support Saudis with jets"
en.summary: Yemeni Houthi rebels attacked Riyadh and warned Italy they are not in conflict with Rome, while questioning the presence of Italian aircraft in Saudi Arabia. The incident represents an escalation on the ground with a missile strike on the capital's airport.

stories.title: Prof accoltellata a Roma, il video choc del 13enne che prepara l'assalto in bagno e poi affonda il colpo

en.title: Teacher stabbed in Rome, shocking video of 13-year-old preparing assault in bathroom and striking
en.summary: Video footage showed a 13-year-old student preparing an attack in a school bathroom before assaulting his teacher in class in Rome on Friday. Another student intervened to stop the assault.

stories.title: Sandro Mazzola, il figlio del Grande Torino diventato icona dell’Inter

en.title: Sandro Mazzola, son of Grande Torino who became an Inter icon
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, son of Valentino Mazzola, won four Serie A titles and two European Cups during 17 seasons with Inter. He also won the 1968 European Championship with Italy.

stories.title: Seda vince l’European Carton Excellence Award 2026 con un nuovo imballaggio

en.title: Seda wins European Carton Excellence Award 2026 with new packaging
en.summary: Seda International Packaging Group won the Food category of the European Carton Excellence Award 2026 with an innovative cardboard packaging solution called Da Vinci Clamshell for food service.

stories.title: Chimica e farmaceutica lanciano un’analsul lavoro e la svolta tecnologica

en.title: Chemistry and pharmaceuticals launch analysis on work and technological shift
en.summary: The chemistry and pharmaceutical sectors are conducting a study through the University of Milan to examine labor developments and technological changes, with results informing future industrial relations discussions.

stories.title: Sanlorenzo: «Con Swan integrazione chiusa molto positivamente»

en.title: Sanlorenzo: Swan integration closure very positive
en.summary: Sanlorenzo reports positive completion of the Swan integration, with activity continuing at the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda during the 23rd Rolex Swan Cup regatta.

stories.title: Meccanica, Stm accelera sul mercato inglese

en.title: Mechanics, Stm accelerates in the English market
en.summary: Stm, a Bologna-based reducer and geared motor manufacturer, is expanding its UK presence beyond its current commercial operations with new market development plans.

stories.title: Biomedicale, da Palermo la rete delle competenze

en.title: Biomedical, competence network from Palermo
en.summary: Twenty new biomedical and biotech laboratories have opened in Palermo, creating an integrated network connecting education, industry, research, and healthcare systems.
